title: Koszul orthogonality propagates to positive powers
statement: Let A be a commutative ring, r≥0, f:Fin(r)→A and X=Spec(A) [def-pc-scheme], with a chosen derived category D(O_X) [def-pc-derived-category]. For a tuple g, let K(g) be the Koszul complex [def-weil-pbc-koszul-complex], extended to cochain degrees −q, sheafified termwise and localized. Let E be any object of D(O_X). If Hom(K(f)[n],E)=0 for all n∈ℤ, then for every e:Fin(r)→ℕ with e_i>0 and every n∈ℤ one has Hom(K((f_i^{e_i})_i)[n],E)=0. No quasi-coherence assumption on E is needed.

source.place: Tag 09IR, lemma-orthogonal-koszul-complex, Koszul multiplication triangles; More on Algebra, Tag 062C, lemma-koszul-mult

proof.text: For any coordinate i and positive a,b, tensor the cone triangle for multiplication by f_i^a and f_i^b with the Koszul complexes on the other coordinates. Equivalently apply lemma-koszul-mult and permute the chosen coordinate to the last position. The complex with exponent a+b is an extension of the complexes with exponents a and b, up to shifts. Sheafification and localization preserve these triangles, since the other factors are bounded finite free complexes.

source.place: Tag 09IR, lemma-orthogonal-koszul-complex, Koszul multiplication triangles; More on Algebra, Tag 062C, lemma-koszul-mult

proof.text: Induct on ∑ᵢ(e_i−1). At zero all e_i=1. Otherwise choose i with e_i=m+1 and m>0. In the triangle just constructed put a=m and b=1 and keep the other exponents fixed. Both outer exponent tuples have strictly smaller sums. Their Hom groups into E vanish in all shifts by induction; exactness of Hom on the triangle makes the middle group vanish. For r=0 the base case is the only case.

theorem koszul_powers_orthogonal_of_orthogonal
    (A : Type u) [CommRing A] (r : ℕ) (f : Fin r → A)
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w}
      (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings (Spec (.of A)).toRingedSpace))]
    (E : schemeDerivedCategory (Spec (.of A)))
    (horth : ∀ n : ℤ, Subsingleton ((DerivedCategory.Q.obj
          ((@Functor.mapHomologicalComplex ℤ (ModuleCat.{u} A)
            (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings (Spec (.of A)).toRingedSpace))
            _ _ _ _ (tilde.functor (.of A))
            ⟨fun _ _ ↦ tilde.map_zero⟩ (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj
            ((ExteriorAlgebra.koszulComplex A r f).extend
              ComplexShape.embeddingDownNat)))⟦n⟧ ⟶ E))
    (e : Fin r → ℕ) (he : ∀ i, 0 < e i) (n : ℤ) :
    Subsingleton ((DerivedCategory.Q.obj
          ((@Functor.mapHomologicalComplex ℤ (ModuleCat.{u} A)
            (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings (Spec (.of A)).toRingedSpace))
            _ _ _ _ (tilde.functor (.of A))
            ⟨fun _ _ ↦ tilde.map_zero⟩ (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj
            ((ExteriorAlgebra.koszulComplex A r (fun i ↦ f i ^ e i)).extend
              ComplexShape.embeddingDownNat)))⟦n⟧ ⟶ E)
